What is the mean ratio for roadside vs general stations? Return both means rounded to 3 decimal places and the station with the highest ratio (most photochemically aged air) along with its ratio.

code_snippets:
import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Query to compute daily average photochemical oxidant partitioning ratio for each station on October 5, 2025
# Photochemical oxidant partitioning ratio = O3 / (O3 + NO2)
# Only include hours where both O3 and NO2 are available (not null)

query = text("""
SELECT 
    aqs.id as station_id,
    aqs.name_en as station_name,
    aqs.station_type,
    AVG(hsaq.o3 / (hsaq.o3 + hsaq.no2)) as avg_ox_ratio
FROM hourly_station_air_quality hsaq
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON hsaq.station_id = aqs.id
WHERE hsaq.datetime >= '2025-10-05 00:00:00'
    AND hsaq.datetime < '2025-10-06 00:00:00'
    AND hsaq.o3 IS NOT NULL
    AND hsaq.no2 IS NOT NULL
    AND (hsaq.o3 + hsaq.no2) > 0
GROUP BY aqs.id, aqs.name_en, aqs.station_type
ORDER BY avg_ox_ratio DESC
""")

df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(df)

import pandas as pd

# Calculate mean ratios for each station type
roadside_df = df[df['station_type'] == 'ROADSIDE']
general_df = df[df['station_type'] == 'GENERAL']

roadside_ox_ratio = round(roadside_df['avg_ox_ratio'].mean(), 3)
general_ox_ratio = round(general_df['avg_ox_ratio'].mean(), 3)

# Find station with highest ratio
highest_idx = df['avg_ox_ratio'].idxmax()
highest_ox_station = df.loc[highest_idx, 'station_name']
highest_ox_ratio = round(df.loc[highest_idx, 'avg_ox_ratio'], 3)

print(f"Roadside mean ratio: {roadside_ox_ratio}")
print(f"General mean ratio: {general_ox_ratio}")
print(f"Highest ratio station: {highest_ox_station}")
print(f"Highest ratio: {highest_ox_ratio}")

# Store results
roadside_ox_ratio = roadside_ox_ratio
general_ox_ratio = general_ox_ratio
highest_ox_station = highest_ox_station
highest_ox_ratio = highest_ox_ratio

# Now I need to compute the photochemical oxidant partitioning ratio for the highest-ratio station (Tap Mun)
# for three time periods: morning (06:00-09:00), midday (11:00-14:00), and evening (17:00-20:00)

query = text("""
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsaq.datetime) as hour,
    hsaq.o3,
    hsaq.no2,
    hsaq.o3 / (hsaq.o3 + hsaq.no2) as ox_ratio
FROM hourly_station_air_quality hsaq
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON hsaq.station_id = aqs.id
WHERE aqs.name_en = 'Tap Mun'
    AND hsaq.datetime >= '2025-10-05 00:00:00'
    AND hsaq.datetime < '2025-10-06 00:00:00'
    AND hsaq.o3 IS NOT NULL
    AND hsaq.no2 IS NOT NULL
    AND (hsaq.o3 + hsaq.no2) > 0
ORDER BY hsaq.datetime
""")

tap_mun_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(tap_mun_df)

# Calculate mean ox_ratio for each time period at Tap Mun station
# Morning: 06:00-09:00 (hours 6, 7, 8, 9 - start inclusive, end exclusive means 6,7,8)
# Actually based on time-window conventions: "HH:MM to HH:MM" is start-inclusive and end-exclusive
# So 06:00-09:00 means hours 6, 7, 8 (not including 9)
# 11:00-14:00 means hours 11, 12, 13
# 17:00-20:00 means hours 17, 18, 19

morning_df = tap_mun_df[(tap_mun_df['hour'] >= 6) & (tap_mun_df['hour'] < 9)]
midday_df = tap_mun_df[(tap_mun_df['hour'] >= 11) & (tap_mun_df['hour'] < 14)]
evening_df = tap_mun_df[(tap_mun_df['hour'] >= 17) & (tap_mun_df['hour'] < 20)]

morning_ox = round(morning_df['ox_ratio'].mean(), 3)
midday_ox = round(midday_df['ox_ratio'].mean(), 3)
evening_ox = round(evening_df['ox_ratio'].mean(), 3)

print(f"Morning (06:00-09:00) ox_ratio: {morning_ox}")
print(f"Midday (11:00-14:00) ox_ratio: {midday_ox}")
print(f"Evening (17:00-20:00) ox_ratio: {evening_ox}")

# Store all results
roadside_ox_ratio = 0.527
general_ox_ratio = 0.811
highest_ox_station = "Tap Mun"
highest_ox_ratio = 0.964
morning_ox = morning_ox
midday_ox = midday_ox
evening_ox = evening_ox
